simple.meaning: גַּנָּה (gannâh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a garden.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 12 times across Numbers, Job, Ecclesiastes, Isaiah, Jeremiah, and 1 more, beginning at Numbers 24:6. Its meaning is built by comparing the passages where Scripture uses it.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to גַּנָּה (H1593).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.

definitions.full: H1593. gannah גַּנָּה noun feminine garden (compare foregoing) — גַּנָּה Isa 1:30 ; 61:11 ; construct גִּנַּת Song 6:11 3 t.; suffix גַּנָּתוֺ Job 8:16 ; plural גַּנֹּת Num 24:6 , גַּנּוֺת Eccl 2:5-6 t.; suffix גַּנּוֺתֵיכֶם Amos 4:9 ; garden, orchard , 4:9 (|| זַיִת תְּאֵנָה, כֶּרֶם, ), 9:14 (fruit-garden; || כֶּרֶם ), Jer 29:5 , 28 ; Eccl 2:5 (|| מַּרְדֵּס ), אֱגוֺז גִּנַּת Song 6:11 nut-garden; compare גִּנַּתבִּֿיתָן Est 1:5 ; 7:7-8 , in simile, of prosperous Israel Num 24:6 (poem in J E; עֲלַינָהָר׳ג ), of chastised Israel Isa 1:30 ( ג לָהּ אין מים ׳אשׁר ), of Yahweh's blessing 61:11 ; in Job 8:16 עַלגַּֿנּוֺ in figure of prosperity of wicked, as a luxuriant plant; gardens as places of idolatrous worship Isa 1:29 (|| אֵילִים ), 65:3 (|| לְבֵנִים ), 66:17 (i.e. groves).

occurrences.englishText: As valleys they are spread out,
He is green before the sun.
I made myself gardens and parks, and I planted trees in them of all kinds of fruit.
For they shall be ashamed of the oaks which you have desired,
For you shall be as an oak whose leaf fades,
For as the earth produces its bud,
a people who provoke me to my face continually,

“Those who sanctify themselves and purify themselves to go to the gardens, behind one in the middle, eating pig’s meat, abominable things, and the mouse, they shall come to an end together,” says Yahweh.
“Build houses and dwell in them. Plant gardens and eat their fruit.
because he has sent to us in Babylon, saying, The captivity is long. Build houses, and dwell in them. Plant gardens, and eat their fruit?” ’ ”
